name: sellerclaw
description: Operate your SellerClaw e-commerce and marketing channels from Claude — eBay, Shopify, Amazon, Meta Ads, Google Ads and more.
long_description: SellerClaw connects your e-commerce and marketing channels — eBay, Shopify, Amazon, Meta Ads, Google Ads and more — and this extension lets you operate them from Claude. Nothing to install first: the extension talks to SellerClaw's hosted MCP server, so there is no Python, no uv and no CLI to set up. Ask Claude to sign in (the `sellerclaw_login` tool opens your browser to approve access — no API key to copy), then browse command groups, read a command's schema, and run it through three discovery tools. Some answers come back as interactive cards you can act on right in the conversation — what needs you today, a store's numbers, your orders and listings, a product with its supplier and every store it is on, your ads, the health of your connections, and anything waiting for your approval. Some actions (e.g. sending email or launching ad campaigns) still require the owner's approval, enforced server-side.

tools.name: sellerclaw_guide
tools.description: Read a task guide with ready-to-run examples: listings, orders, ads, research, analytics.

tools.name: sellerclaw_groups
tools.description: List SellerClaw command groups and the commands inside each.

tools.name: sellerclaw_describe
tools.description: Show one command's full schema: arguments, filters and body fields.

tools.name: sellerclaw_run
tools.description: Run a SellerClaw command and return the API response.

tools.name: sellerclaw_store_summary
tools.description: Show how a store is doing as an interactive card: revenue, orders, profit and best sellers.

tools.name: sellerclaw_orders
tools.description: Show the order board as an interactive card: who is waiting, for how long, for how much.

tools.name: sellerclaw_approval
tools.description: Show something waiting on you as a card, with the buttons to approve or decline it.

tools.name: sellerclaw_attention
tools.description: Show what needs you right now as an interactive card: the verdict and the queue behind it.

tools.name: sellerclaw_listings
tools.description: Show your listings as an interactive card: which sell, which don't and why, one in full.

tools.name: sellerclaw_products
tools.description: Show a product from your catalog as a card: its supplier, cost, stock and every store it is listed in.

tools.name: sellerclaw_ads
tools.description: Show your ads across Google, Meta and eBay as an interactive card: spend, sales and return.

tools.name: sellerclaw_connections
tools.description: Show your connections as an interactive card, broken ones first with the page that fixes them.

tools.name: sellerclaw_login
tools.description: Sign in to SellerClaw by approving access in the browser.

token.title: SellerClaw token (optional)
token.description: Leave this empty — ask Claude to sign you in and approve access in the browser. Fill it in only for headless setups: an agent token (starts with `sca_`), or one you already have from `sellerclaw auth login`.
